artworks.title: Antonio Zingano
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.2 × 8.2 cm (5 3/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a deathbed scene with multiple figures surrounding a bed, with one person lying on it. There are individuals wearing pointed hoods holding torches, and another figure in clerical robes gesturing with a staff topped with a skull-like object. The scene includes a chair with a skull motif. The drawing is detailed and shaded, giving it a historical feel. The inscription refers to Antonio Zingano and mentions a return to life.

artworks.title: Niccolo
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.1 × 8.2 cm (5 3/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is an interior scene depicting individuals engaged in an activity. The image shows several individuals wearing distinctive garments, seated around a table set with plates and other dining items. They are seated on a richly decorated textile. To the left, there is a figure standing with chains hanging from their hand. The architecture features classic columns and drapery. The composition is detailed, with deliberate etching to convey texture and depth within the scene.

artworks.title: Bartolomeo
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13 × 8.1 cm (5 1/8 × 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical battle scene. The image shows armored figures engaged in combat. In the foreground, a fallen soldier lies on the ground with a shield beside them, while two standing figures prepare for further confrontation. The scene is filled with soldiers wearing helmets and armor, many of them carrying pikes and shields. The background is crowded with more warriors, creating a turbulent atmosphere typical of a pitched battle. Sharp diagonal lines suggest movement and tension, and detailed engraving emphasizes the texture of the armor and weapons.

artworks.title: Pietro Soderini
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.4 × 8.5 cm (5 1/4 × 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a scene with multiple individuals in a room with classical architecture. In the foreground, a person is standing beside a table, holding a jug and setting a plate. To the right, a figure is reclining on a bed. Two figures on the right are standing, draped in robes. In the upper left, there are smaller figures seated opposite each other with a winged figure nearby. The background features detailed room elements like curtains and architectural beams. The engraving is richly detailed and classical in style.

artworks.title: Pietro dal Monte
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 13.3 × 8.3 cm (5 1/4 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a landscape. One figure, wearing a wide-brimmed hat and period clothing, is firing a rifle or musket. The other figure is gesturing dramatically. The background features detailed foliage, trees, and an architectural structure. The drawing showcases Baroque-style etching techniques and includes Italian text below it.

artworks.title: Spadino
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.1 × 8.3 cm (5 3/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bear and a man in a natural setting. The bear is standing upright, facing the man who is gesturing towards it. The background shows hills, trees, figures on horseback and on foot, and a small structure resembling a house or barn. There is an Italian inscription at the bottom. The drawing is detailed with precise line work and shading.

artworks.title: Accursio
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.5 × 8.5 cm (5 5/16 × 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a courtyard. In the scene, a figure is falling from the upper windows of a building, while several other figures in historical attire are in the courtyard below gesturing towards the falling figure. In the sky above, two ethereal figures rest on clouds, with one holding a vertical object. The architecture includes arched windows and an inner courtyard setting, with dark clouds swirling around the celestial figures. The drawing is done with intricate line work and cross-hatching, resembling detailed engravings from a classical period.

artworks.title: Rocco
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 13 × 7.9 cm (5 1/8 × 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a battle scene with armor-clad figures in dynamic motion. The scene shows an armored figure being assisted by another, with soldiers in the background. The etching style suggests classical or Renaissance influence with detailed linework and shading. The figures wear traditional armor and the scene conveys drama and movement. The background features a landscape with trees and hills, and there is a caption at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Domenico di Giusto
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.4 × 8.4 cm (5 1/4 × 3 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man trapped in the debris of a collapsed building. His torso, head, arms, and one leg are visible. He has a long, curly beard and short hair, and is wearing long-sleeved clothing. He has one hand raised to his chest. Surrounding him are rubble and architectural fragments. In the cloudy sky above, there are two seated figures that appear indistinct. The scene is depicted in an old illustration style.

artworks.title: Margherita
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 13.4 × 8.4 cm (5 1/4 × 3 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures inside a sacred or religious setting. Two figures are standing on steps or a platform on the right side, with one reaching towards a seated figure on the left. The seated figure, with a serene expression, is in front of columns and a patterned wall. Several women are present, standing near the steps with their bodies angled towards the seated figure. The women wear long robes and headscarves with detailed texture. An image within the space shows a figure with a halo. The background has architectural patterns. Italian text is inscribed below the scene.

artworks.title: Gioanni
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.5 × 8.4 cm (5 5/16 × 3 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with ornate furnishings and figures in historical attire. The drawing shows several figures around a kneeling man before an altar or niche. In the background, there is a large canopied bed with draped curtains. The figures wear detailed period garments and exhibit various poses and expressions. In the lower margin, there is a block of text in Italian. The drawing is detailed with attention to fabric folds and architectural elements.

artworks.title: Antonia
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 13.1 × 8.1 cm (5 3/16 × 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene inside a chapel. The image depicts a detailed interior with an altar in the background adorned with tall candlesticks and a central religious icon or sculpture. The foreground has several figures in flowing garments, gesturing and positioned in various stances. Some crutches are placed on the floor. The figures are intricately detailed with careful attention to drapery and texture. There is also an inscription in Italian below the image.

artworks.title: Lionardo
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13 × 8 cm (5 1/8 × 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a group of figures gathered around an ornate altar. The altar is richly decorated with candlesticks and urns, and features a small bust at its center. In the foreground, a person gestures towards the altar with a crutch nearby. To the right, a group of figures watches attentively, with some pointing towards the main figure and altar. The illustration is rendered in a style that emphasizes textures and architectural elements.

artworks.title: Mariotto di Martino
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 13.5 × 8.2 cm (5 5/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene involving judicial proceedings or interrogation. The drawing depicts a dimly lit interior where a figure is suspended by their wrists from the ceiling, being observed by several other figures. The suspended figure is stripped. To the right, there are three seated individuals. On the left, a figure appears to be gesturing or explaining something. The room is sparsely furnished, with a side table visible in the foreground.

artworks.title: Domenico
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.3 × 8.5 cm (5 1/4 × 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting an interior scene with architectural elements and figures engaged in an event. The interior space includes large columns with carvings, an arched ceiling, and several figures with expressive gestures. One figure appears to be emerging from a kneeling position, with others nearby showing varied emotions. In the background, another group of figures gathers near a raised platform, adding depth to the scene. The drawing features intricate line work and exaggerated expressions, hinting at a storytelling purpose.

artworks.title: Maddalena
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 13 × 8 cm (5 1/8 × 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene set on a cobblestone street lined with tall buildings. The drawing illustrates multiple figures interacting, with a central figure gesturing animatedly. She appears to be in distress or surprise, holding a hand to her mouth. Other figures are engaged with each other or looking towards a disturbance. The detailed architecture in the background suggests a cityscape with Italian-inspired design. The drawing uses fine line work to create texture, typical of engravings. A text below the image seems to describe the scene.

artworks.title: Bernardo
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13 × 8.2 cm (5 1/8 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a man kneeling under a tree surrounded by soldiers. The image shows a man beneath a tree with ropes hanging from the branches above him. In the foreground, there are armed soldiers on horses, while another group of soldiers marches in formation in the background. The landscape includes rolling hills, encampments, and small fortifications, suggesting a military setting. The drawing features detailed etchings that convey the tension and drama of the scene through line work depicting the figures and the natural surroundings.

artworks.title: The Captain
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.3 × 8.3 cm (5 1/4 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This drawing portrays a cavalry charge against a group of infantry soldiers. It shows a formation of soldiers on foot armed with long spears pointed upwards. In front of them, a rider on a rearing horse, clad in armor, is depicted. The horse's motion is dynamic. The drawing is detailed with fine lines, showing textures in the armor and horse's mane. The soldiers' helmets and armor reflect the style of historical European warfare. Underneath the image is an inscription in Italian.

artworks.title: Mariotto
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13 × 8.1 cm (5 1/8 × 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene involving a tied figure and onlookers. The central figure is tied to a post with flames around the base. The surrounding individuals have different actions and expressions. The setting includes a coastal backdrop with ships and a distant landscape. The etching showcases detailed clothing, highlighting the historical period. The scene is framed by a text caption at the bottom.

artworks.title: Sino
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.3 × 8.3 cm (5 1/4 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This image shows a group of men in armor and period clothing, surrounded by spears. One man in the center is bound and escorted by soldiers. In the background, there is a battle scene with mounted soldiers and fighting. There is Italian text below the illustration.

artworks.title: Marco Cambini
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13 × 8.4 cm (5 1/8 × 3 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a confrontation in a rustic landscape. Three figures are overpowering a fourth figure, who appears wounded and holding his head. The figures are armed and wearing historical garments. The background shows trees, a body of water, and a distant boat. The detailed texture and line work resemble a historical etching. Text at the bottom suggests a narrative for the image.

artworks.title: Francesco
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.2 × 8.3 cm (5 3/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is an illustration of an execution scene with a guillotine. The image shows a person standing under the guillotine as the blade remains suspended, surrounded by a crowd of onlookers with various reactions. The artwork features detailed linework and a sense of depth and is reminiscent of the style of Antoninus Tempestinus.

artworks.title: Gherardo
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 13.3 × 8 cm (5 1/4 × 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is an image of men in a historical setting engaged in a confrontation. Several individuals in historical attire, each wearing feathered hats, are seen in an altercation. One figure holds a long-handled axe, while another wields a sword, tapping a third figure with the tip of their sword. The background shows architectural elements like columns and arches, indicating a historic European city. The image also includes text in Italian. Detailed hatching and cross-hatching give the image a sense of depth and texture typical of prints from the Renaissance or Baroque period.

artworks.title: Bastiano
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13 × 8.5 cm (5 1/8 × 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting three figures in a narrow street or alley with classic architecture in the background. One figure is restraining another who is on the ground, while a third figure with a sword is involved. The artwork is detailed with intricate lines and shading on the figures and architecture, creating a strong narrative quality. The text beneath the image provides context about the encounter.
